description: This file defines various TypeScript types, utility functions, and collection manipulation functions related to data relations, partial types, and type guards within the Mattermost project.

methods.name: isArrayOf
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is an array of elements passing a check function.

methods.name: isStringArray
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is an array of strings.

methods.name: isRecordOf
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a record with string keys and values passing a check function.

methods.name: collectionFromArray
methods.description: Creates an IDMappedCollection from an array of objects with 'id' property.

methods.name: collectionToArray
methods.description: Converts an IDMappedCollection back to an array of objects.

methods.name: collectionReplaceItem
methods.description: Replaces items in a collection with new items.

methods.name: collectionAddItem
methods.description: Adds new items to a collection.

methods.name: collectionRemoveItem
methods.description: Removes an item from a collection.

methods.name: idMappedObjectsFromArr
methods.description: Creates an object mapping IDs to objects from an array.
